title: xylocarpus carapa
intro: Xylocarpus carapa, commonly known as Mallows Tree or Carapa, is a tropical tree species belonging to the family Rhizophoraceae. The bark and heartwood of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Xylocarpus carapa include reducing fever, treating wounds, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
